headlines.title: Scott Colom blasts Democrats for not investing more in Mississippi
headlines.description: Mississippi U.S. Senate candidate Scott Colom (D) says Democrats did not do enough to be competitive in the state as the Senate race remains too close to call. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor joins Meet the Press NOW with more from her interview.

headlines.title: Head of DOJ Civil Rights Division resigns after GOP midterms loss
headlines.description: Harmeet Dhillon oversaw a massive overhaul of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, targeting universities and focusing on culture war issues.

headlines.title: California Gov. Newsom commutes all death sentences in the state
headlines.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has commuted all death sentences in the state, saying he opposes "state-sanctioned killing." NBC News' Danny Cevallos has details on the governor's decision.

headlines.title: LIV Golf plans to shut down
headlines.description: LIV Golf, the golf tour backed by Saudi royalty and big names in the sport, is planning to shut down. NBC News' Andrew Greif reports on the decision and what could come next for the players.

headlines.title: Wisconsin reports its first measles death in decades, the third in the U.S. this week
headlines.description: The infant’s death followed a measles-associated death reported Wednesday in Pennsylvania and another Monday in New York.

headlines.title: Melania Trump on Oleshky ceasefire: Russia and Ukraine have chosen 'humanity over war'
headlines.description: First lady Melania Trump hosted delegations from Russia and Ukraine to highlight the humanitarian ceasefire she helped broker in Oleshky. She praised the countries for choosing "humanity over war" by following through with the agreement.

headlines.title: Wave of Bomb Threats Target Flights All Across Europe
headlines.description: Flights across Europe have been targeted in a wave of alarming bomb threats. There have been no casualties, and no explosives have so far been found, but officials are taking precautions with bomb squads deployed in airports across the continent. NBC’s Daniele Hamamdjian reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault in London court
headlines.description: British comedian and actor Russell Brand was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. Ultimately he was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He ⁠was acquitted of ⁠the other charges.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Affording America: The rising costs of family farming
headlines.description: Javier Zamora achieved his dream of starting his own family farm and watching his customer base grow, but as the costs of labor, chemicals, and diesel have risen, his profit margins have continued to fall.

headlines.title: An Oregon college student was held at knifepoint by his brother. He escaped, and police shot him.
headlines.description: Maverick Lyon, a college lacrosse player, filed a federal civil rights case alleging excessive force and negligence on the part of the city of Albany and Benton County.
